title: Optimization-like Reasoning in LLMs over Expanding Search Spaces
abstract: arXiv:2606.05464v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Verifiable reward training has improved mathematical and coding reasoning, but these domains capture only part of step-by-step decision making. Many real-world tasks require finding a high-value feasible plan among many valid alternatives. We introduce OPT*, a scalable family of optimization-style tasks for training and evaluating LLM step-by-step optimization-like reasoning along a complexity axis: each task provides a feasibility checker and evaluator, while a complexity parameter expands the search space without requiring new human labels. This motivates studying these tasks in two regimes: (i) solver-guided online policy optimization, which uses a solver as a value oracle for partial states and applies rank-based reward shaping to reinforce better next steps, and (ii) search-based offline RL when such solvers are unavailable. translated_title: 大语言模型在扩展搜索空间中的类优化推理
translated_abstract: 可验证奖励训练已经提升了数学和编程领域的推理能力，但这些领域只涵盖了逐步决策制定的一部分。许多现实世界的任务需要在众多有效备选方案中寻找高价值的可行计划。我们提出了 OPT*，这是一个可扩展的优化类任务家族，用于沿复杂度维度训练和评估大语言模型的逐步类优化推理能力：每个任务提供可行性检查器和评估器，同时通过一个复杂度参数扩展搜索空间，无需新的人工标注。这促使我们在两种情形下研究这些任务：（i）求解器引导的在线策略优化，该方法使用求解器作为部分状态的价值预言机，并应用基于排名的奖励塑形来强化更好的下一步动作；（ii）当此类求解器不可用时，采用基于搜索的离线强化学习。在理论方面，我们将推理器在大搜索空间中的成功与其每单位（时间）所提取的信息量联系起来。
tldr: 本文提出可扩展的优化类任务家族 OPT*，通过复杂度参数扩展搜索空间，并支持求解器引导的在线策略优化与基于搜索的离线强化学习两种训练范式，以培养和评估大语言模型的逐步类优化推理能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces OPT*, a scalable family of optimization-style tasks with a complexity parameter that expands search spaces without new labels, enabling LLM training via solver-guided online policy optimization or search-based offline RL to foster step-by-step optimization-like reasoning.
